subject.title: perf(ci): run the deadcode Knip scans concurrently

question: Does the measured exact-head `check-dependencies` run justify seven-process Knip concurrency on the 16-vCPU runner?
rationale: Runner capacity and CI cost are repository operational choices, and the supplied evidence does not yet include the completed hosted lane needed to confirm the tradeoff.

options.title: Approve after hosted proof
options.body: Merge after the refreshed head shows correct diagnostics and failure handling with acceptable duration, memory, and billed-resource results.

options.title: Reduce concurrency
options.body: Parallelize only the three top-level scripts or only each script's internal scans if full fan-out creates excessive resource pressure or cost.

options.title: Keep the serial lane
options.body: Decline the optimization if the hosted measurement does not produce a material end-to-end CI benefit.

recommendation.title: Approve after hosted proof
recommendation.body: Merge after the refreshed head shows correct diagnostics and failure handling with acceptable duration, memory, and billed-resource results.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR's maintainer signal and coordinated capacity change make the author the best available owner for confirming the intended CI tradeoff.
